papers.title: Reflection Separation from a Single Image via Joint Latent Diffusion
papers.authors: Zheng-Hui Huang, Zhixiang Wang, Yu-Lun Liu, Yung-Yu Chuang
papers.affiliations: Shanda AI Research Tokyo, National Taiwan University, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种联合潜扩散模型，通过微调预训练扩散模型、设计跨层自注意力和不相交采样策略，同时生成透射层和反射层，实现鲁棒的单图反射分离。

papers.title: Demo2Tutorial: From Human Experience to Multimodal Software Tutorials
papers.authors: Zechen Bai, Zhiheng Chen, Yiqi Lin, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Difei Gao, Xiangwu Guo, Xin Wang, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.affiliations: Show Lab, National University of Singapore
papers.intro: Demo2Tutorial是一个智能体框架，通过专用记录器采集人类电脑操作，利用VLM进行动作语义解析，再经逐步规划和迭代优化，最终自动生成包含图像和文本的结构化多模态软件教程，并在人类学习和GUI代理任务中证明其有效性。

papers.title: CLI-Anything: Towards Agent-Native Computer Use
papers.authors: Yuhao Yang, Tianyu Fan, Chao Huang
papers.affiliations: University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 论文提出CLI-Anything框架，主张通过将现有应用程序转化为状态化命令行（CLI）接口（harness），为智能体提供结构化命令、显式状态和确定性反馈的“智能体原生”计算机使用方式，并构建了CLI-Hub平台进行分发和集成。

papers.title: Knowledge-Preserved Model Tuning in Null-Space for Robust Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
papers.authors: Haoxuan Chen, Xianqin Liu, Jian-Fang Hu
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science and Engineering, Sun Yat-sen University（中山大学计算机科学与工程学院）；National Information Center of GACC (Guangdong)（海关总署广东分署信息中心）；Guangdong Province Key Laboratory of Information Security Technology；Key Laboratory of Machine Intelligence and Advanced Computing, Ministry of Education
papers.intro: 本文提出空空间微调（Null-Space Tuning，NST）框架，利用冻结权重的零空间几何性质，将高质量输入的调整信号约束在零空间内从而对预训练输出严格不可见，同时将低质量输入的恢复信号导向非零空间，实现了"质量自适应"的鲁棒时空视频定位微调。

papers.title: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6: Expanding the Frontier of Document Parsing with Under-Optimized Region Refinement and Progressive Post-Training
papers.authors: Zelun Zhang, Hongen Liu, Suyin Liang, Yubo Zhang, Yiqing Xiang, Jiaxuan Liu, Ting Sun, Manhui Lin, Yue Zhang, Changda Zhou, Tingquan Gao, Cheng Cui, Yi Liu, Dianhai Yu, Yanjun Ma
papers.affiliations: Baidu Inc
papers.intro: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 通过引入“欠优化区域驱动数据引擎”和“渐进式后训练配方”，在不扩大模型规模（保持0.9B参数）的前提下，在OmniDocBench v1.6上达到96.33%的SOTA分数，有效提升了紧凑型文档解析模型在边界脆弱、覆盖稀疏、监督不可靠等区域的性能。

papers.title: The Road Ahead in Autonomous Driving: The KITScenes Multimodal Dataset
papers.authors: Richard Schwarzkopf, Fabian Immel, Alexander Blumberg, Jonas Merkert, Nils Rack, Kaiwen Wang, Fabian Konstantinidis, Julian Truetsch, Carlos Fernandez, Annika Bätz, Kevin Rösch, Marlon Steiner, Willi Poh, Yinzhe Shen, Royden Wagner, Felix Hauser, Dominik Strutz, Jaime Villa, Gleb Stepanov, Holger Caesar, Ömer Şahin Taş, Frank Bieder, Jan-Hendrik Pauls, Christoph Stiller
papers.tags: autonomous driving, BEV perception, depth estimation, 3D reconstruction, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: FZI Research Center for Information Technology, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, University Charles III of Madrid, Delft University of Technology
papers.intro: 论文提出了KITScenes Multimodal数据集，这是一个基于高保真传感器（高分辨率全局快门相机、400米以上远程激光雷达、4D成像雷达）和最完整的Lanelet2 HD地图的欧洲自动驾驶多模态数据集，并引入了在线HD地图构建、远程深度估计、新视角合成和端到端驾驶四个基准测试。

papers.title: SCOPE: Real-Time Natural Language Camera Agent at the Edge
papers.authors: Nikolaj Hindsbo, Sina Ehsani, Pragyana Mishra
papers.affiliations: Armada AI
papers.intro: 本文提出SCOPE，一个模块化的、用于自然语言控制PTZ摄像头的边缘智能体系统，并配套发布了一个包含536个任务的Blender仿真基准测试，通过对19种规划器-感知器模型组合的系统评估，揭示了在边缘部署中实现实时、可靠语言驱动控制的设计关键。

papers.title: BYORn: Bootstrap Your Own Responses to Defend Large Vision-Language Models Against Backdoor Attacks
papers.authors: Ivan Sabolić, Marin Oršić, Josip Šarić, Sven Lončarić
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image captioning, visual question answering
papers.affiliations: Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing, University of Zagreb, Croatia
papers.intro: BYORn 通过利用预训练模型检测语义不匹配的后门样本，并动态地将疑似中毒响应替换为模型自身生成的干净响应，从而打破触发器与目标输出之间的关联，实现后门鲁棒的监督微调。

papers.title: BEAST3D: Animal behavioral analysis and neural encoding from multi-view video via Gaussian splatting
papers.authors: Yanchen Wang, Lenny Aharon, Wangshu Zhu, Kyle Daruwalla, Linghua Zhang, Jiaru Zou, Selmaan Chettih, Helen Hou, Liam Paninski, Matthew R Whiteway
papers.affiliations: Columbia University, Cold Spring Harbor, Stanford University
papers.intro: BEAST3D是一个自监督预训练框架，利用3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）从无标注、校准的多视角视频中学习3D视觉特征，该特征可直接迁移到新颖视图合成、多视角姿态估计和神经编码等下游任务，并在四个物种（小鼠、大鼠、山雀、人类）上取得优于通用模型的结果。

papers.title: ATLAS: A Large-Scale Evaluation Benchmark for Adversarial LiDAR Perception
papers.authors: Mellon M. Zhang, Siddhant Panse, Zimo Fan, Akshal Dhal, Rishit Sarkar, Glen Chou
papers.tags: object detection, point cloud, autonomous driving, LiDAR
papers.affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology
papers.intro: ATLAS是首个大规模、物理真实的黑盒对抗性LiDAR感知评估基准，通过模拟点注入和点移除攻击，揭示了现代3D目标检测器中存在的鲁棒性不对称：更强模型对点移除更鲁棒，但对点注入更脆弱。

papers.title: Pixel Cube: Diffusion-based Portrait Video Relighting Through Realistic Lighting Reproduction
papers.authors: Yufan Zhang, Yu Ji, Ayo Ajiboye, Rundi Wu, Yu Guo, Changxi Zheng, Jinwei Ye
papers.affiliations: George Mason University, LightThought LLC, Columbia University
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的动态肖像视频重光照方法，通过构建LED立方体舞台（Pixel Cube）采集真实动态视频数据并结合合成数据，微调视频扩散模型，实现逼真、时间一致且身份保持的肖像视频重光照。

papers.title: Pixel Cube: Diffusion-based Portrait Video Relighting Through Realistic Lighting Reproduction
papers.authors: Yufan Zhang, Yu Ji, Ayo Ajiboye, Rundi Wu, Yu Guo, Changxi Zheng, Jinwei Ye
papers.affiliations: George Mason University (Yufan Zhang, Ayo Ajiboye, Yu Guo, Jinwei Ye), LightThought LLC (Yu Ji), Columbia University (Rundi Wu, Changxi Zheng)
papers.intro: 本文构建LED立方体采集系统（Pixel Cube）获取真实动态视频配对光照数据，结合合成数据微调视频扩散模型，实现照片级真实、时间一致且身份保持的动态肖像视频重打光。

papers.title: Depth from Dual Differential Defocus and Stereo Consensus
papers.authors: Junjie Luo, Wei Xu, Dylan Chu, Emma Alexander, Qi Guo
papers.affiliations: Purdue University (Junjie Luo, Wei Xu, Dylan Chu, Qi Guo); Northwestern University (Emma Alexander)
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于物理的闭式算法D³S Consensus，通过融合双差分离焦（D³）和立体视觉两种独立深度线索的共识，在极紧凑的4 mm基线、12 mm EFL硬件上实现了0.3–1.64 m范围内1 cm平均绝对误差的深度估计，工作范围与10倍基线尺寸的传统立体相机相当。

papers.title: Tiny Collaborative Inference for Occlusion-Robust Object Detection
papers.authors: Chieh-Tung Cheng, Mustafa Aslanov, Eiman Kanjo
papers.affiliations: Imperial College London, United Kingdom; Nottingham Trent University, United Kingdom
papers.intro: 本文提出一种结合MCUNet骨干、YOLOv2检测头和Lite量化的轻量级目标检测管道，通过决策级融合（Weighted Boxes Fusion）实现多设备协作推理，在超低端硬件上显著提升遮挡鲁棒性，并验证了Wi-Fi点对点部署的可行性。

papers.title: Pathway-Structured Privileged Distillation for Deployable Computational Pathology
papers.authors: Yongxin Guo, Hao Lu, Onur Koyun, Zhengjie Zhu, Muhammet Demir, Metin Gurcan
papers.tags: medical image, image classification, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Wake Forest University School of Medicine
papers.intro: 本文提出Mixture of Pathway Experts（MoPE）框架，将RNA通路知识通过记忆使用对齐蒸馏到通路索引的病理专家网络中，实现训练时利用分子信息、推理时仅用WSI的部署，在多个癌症诊断和生存预测任务中显著优于现有WSI单模态和知识蒸馏基线。

papers.title: Automated Report-Derived Oncology VQA Benchmark for Evaluating Vision-Language Models on 3D Medical Imaging
papers.authors: Bo Liu, Hanxue Gu, Xiangru Li, Zheren Zhu, Jacob Ellison, Kang Wang, Janine M. Lupo, Yang Yang, Hui Lin
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, medical image
papers.affiliations: University of California, San Francisco (UCSF)
papers.intro: 本文提出一个自动化管道，利用私有放射学报告和3D肿瘤影像生成临床嵌入的多选VQA基准，并对六种VLM进行零样本评估，发现没有模型达到饱和，且视觉依赖因数据集而异（肝部问题真正需要图像，而肺CT几乎可无图解决）。

papers.title: Towards Resolving Optimization Conflicts Between Image- and Text-Based Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Karina Kvanchiani, Timur Mamedov
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image retrieval, video search
papers.affiliations: Tevian, Russia（Karina Kvanchiani）；Tevian, Russia & Lomonosov Moscow State University, Russia（Timur Mamedov）
papers.intro: 本文系统分析了I2I与T2I ReID之间的优化冲突，提出了一种解耦的两阶段训练流水线：先通过ReText预训练富含身份语义的视觉编码器，再冻结该编码器并用RDE框架训练文本编码器，从而在共享视觉空间中同时实现高质量的I2I和T2I检索。

papers.title: ROGLE: Robust Global-Local Alignment with Automated Region Supervision for Text-Based Person Search
papers.authors: Chaodong Jia, Zequn Xie, Xibei Jia, Sihang Cai, Shulei Wang, Tao Jin
papers.tags: multimodal learning, CLIP, Segment Anything, visual grounding, video search
papers.affiliations: 未明确（通讯作者邮箱域名为zju.edu.cn，推测可能隶属浙江大学，但论文正文未明确给出机构列表）
papers.intro: 提出ROGLE框架，通过自动化的Region-to-Sentence Matching（RSM）生成伪区域-句子对，并融合全局对比学习和区域级局部对齐的多粒度训练策略，同时引入支持全局与局部评估的大规模P-VLG基准，显著提升了文本行人检索（尤其是长句查询）的性能。

papers.title: STaR-KV: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting for KV Cache Compression in GUI Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Yuhang Han, Wenzheng Yang, Yujie Chen, Xiangqi Jin, Yaojie Zhang, Siteng Huang, Linfeng Zhang
papers.affiliations: 上海交通大学（EPIC Lab）、香港科技大学（广州）、悉尼大学、电子科技大学、浙江大学（详细对应见第十二项）
papers.intro: STaR-KV提出一种免训练的三轴KV缓存压缩框架，通过在线空间互信息、累积时间稳定性折扣和自适应熵锐化分别校准token重要性，在GUI VLM上以接近零额外计算开销实现高压缩率下的最强平均性能。

papers.title: Dr. DocBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Expert-Level and Difficult Document Parsing
papers.authors: Minglai Yang, Xinyan Velocity Yu, Pengyuan Li, Xinyu Guo, Zhenting Qi, Konwoo Kim, Longtian Ye, Xiaolong Luo, Jinhe Bi, Henry Zhang, Haris Riaz, Xuan Zhang, Yunze Xiao, Bangya Liu, Tom Tang, Yunfei Zhao, Qunshu Lin, Zihan Wang, Minghao Liu, Michael Lingzhi Li, Yilun Du, Jesse Thomason, Rogerio Feris, Alex Pentland, Zexue He
papers.affiliations: 见第十二节
papers.intro: 本文提出了Dr. DocBench，一个覆盖52个BISAC主题领域、包含4,514页难度感知采样的专家级文档解析基准，通过细粒度页面级和块级标注，系统评估当前最强文档解析系统和通用视觉语言模型，并揭示它们在专业领域和复杂结构上的显著失败。
